help.short: The name of the configuration store.

The composition type describes how the key-values within the snapshot are composed. The 'key' composition type ensures there are no two key-values containing the same key. The 'key_label' composition type ensures there are no two key-values containing the same key and label.
A list of filters used to filter the key-values included in the snapshot.
Filters key-values by their key field.
Filters key-values by their label field.
The tags of the snapshot. NOTE: These are data plane tags, not Azure Resource Manager (ARM) tags.

description: Update a snapshot. NOTE: This operation is intended for use in Azure Resource Manager (ARM) Template deployments. For all other scenarios involving App Configuration snapshots the data plane API should be used instead.
